_provenance.status: PROVISIONAL — no tenancy service or contract exists (see lib/api-client/platform.ts)
note: The platform operator surface (PRD screen inventory 'Platform Dashboard/Tenant Management · Platform Login · Tenant Sign-Up'; classification docs/02-architecture/platform-administration.md): the tenant list and one detail screen, the operator sign-in door and the tenant sign-up flow.

WHAT THIS IS: APP-AUTHORED SAMPLE RECORDS, not a service response and not real customers. The classification document says the platform surface is not tenant-scoped, platform admins are a separate identity type and sign-up creates a tenant + its owner in one transaction — but NO tenancy service, platform identity service or sign-up endpoint exists in this build, and this repository cannot provision a tenant. Every screen that reads this file says so and is read-only.

THE SAMPLES RULE — never let a row be mistaken for a real business. Every record carries sample: true, every name contains 'Sample' or 'Example', every address ends in the reserved .example TLD and every administrator is a .example mailbox. Do not replace these with a real-looking business, plan or hostname: tests/fixture-contract/platform.test.ts fails on any row that is not marked and named as a sample, and the pages render PLATFORM_SAMPLE_NOTE above the table.

VOCABULARY (lib/platform-admin.ts is the one home): state is the trial vocabulary platform-administration.md decision 9 records — active_trial / trial_expired / cancelled with days remaining; plan is free_trial, the only plan that exists while subscription billing is deferred (a paid plan name or figure would be invented). trial_days_remaining is RECORDED state, never recomputed here, and trial_ends_on is exactly provisioned_on + 14 days (the trial length the classification fixes). The fixture-contract test pins both.

WHAT IS NOT HERE: no provisioning endpoint, no operator account, no audit trail and no tenant data — the detail screen shows only what the tenancy service would report and names the platform's deferred work (suspend/delete, custom domains, usage metrics, platform-action audit). The app's cosmetic staff tenant switcher (lib/demo-tenants.ts) is a different, unrelated demo control.
